namespace.description: Extension namespace: uc, labs, or product (product = no namespace in extension name)

file_no.description: File number for ID range calculation

objects.description: Object type hierarchy. Each object defines its parent and which grammar patterns detect it.

parent.description: Parent object type name, or 'file' for objects directly under the source file

pattern_keys.description: Array of pattern names from grammar.patterns that detect this object type. Empty array for auto-created objects like Program.

block_delimiters.description: How code blocks are delimited: 'braces' ({...}), 'end_keyword' (def...end), or 'indentation' (Python-style)

patterns.description: Named patterns to detect code structures. Each pattern is a regex with a named group (?P<name>...) to capture the object name. Pattern names are referenced in objects.*.pattern_keys

additionalProperties.description: Array of regex patterns (multiple patterns can match the same object type)

call_pattern.description: Regex pattern to detect function/method calls. Group 1 must capture the callee name.

keywords.description: Language keywords to exclude from call detection (control flow, declarations, etc.)
